subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large group of people
solution:
The correct answer is **"Horde"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the meaning of the given one word substitute:

__
 
• Horde - a large group of people

 
 
• ***Eg.*** A horde of beery rugby fans
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here lets see the meaning of the other given one word substitute:

 
• **Flock - **a number of birds of one kind feeding, resting, or travelling together

 
 
• ***Eg.*** a *flock *of gulls
 
 
 
• **Convocation - **a large formal assembly of people
 
 
• ***Eg. ***a representative assembly of clergy of the province of Canterbury or York.
 
 
 
• **Herd - **a large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together or are kept together as livestock
 
 
• ***Eg.*** a* herd *of elephants
